content: KAVLE MAAWUT KWAGALALAPMAN NYAN KAVLE YIGIYANDƗ
Tɨga lɨga nat nɨmba yalaa tak njambwi nyan Pailat Galilina nat nɨmba kat vatnyanda vak Jisas kat mbutndi. Ndi God kat kwanda kwanda nda vatnyalaa God kat kwilɨndi, vatnyandɨ waa mbutndi Jisas kat.

Mbutndi mala Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Ngwuk angamak yelavɨka lɨgangwuk. Ndi God kat nɨma sakwat kavle vat yindi, Pailat ndi kat vatnyandɨ? E? Ndina kavle vat Galilina nat nɨmbana kavle vak kat kwulatndɨ? E?
Kai luwa. Wupma kai. Ngwuk kat wowun. Ngwutna kavle maawut kwagalalapman yingweyan yinja vla yigiyangwuk.
Tak Sailoam walɨnja kavamba la sɨvla ngay ndalaa tamba vɨli kiyeli sɨla kuvuk nɨmba kat vatnyandɨ. Ndina kavle vat Jerusalemba la nat nɨmbana kavle vak kat kwulatndɨ? E? Ana kwulatndɨ?
Kai ana kwulatndɨ. Ngwuk kat wowun. Kavle maawut kwagalalapman yingweyan yinja vla yigiyangwuk.
SƗK WOGWULAPMAN MINA NYAANGƗT
Jisas ndi kat pagwuga la nyaangɨt mbutndɨ. Kɨta nyan fik walɨnja mi ndɨna ambugapmba sɨk tundɨ. Tɨga lɨga mi sɨk sɨgɨpmak yandɨ. Yandɨ, ana sɨk wagwundɨ.

Ndɨna njɨvwa kwuta nyan kat wandɨɨ. Yaa avɨ. Wan mi naambi kuvuk ana sɨk wogwulɨgandɨ. Vɨlevigowun. Kwulamba avɨk kan mi. Manda kat kwo lɨga kɨpmana kwiya mɨna kɨga kiyagiga lɨgiyandɨ waa wandɨ maa ndɨna njɨvwa kwuta nyan wandɨ.
Njambwi nyan kan naambi mi kwo lɨgiyandɨ. Angwamba waangu valaa bulmakauna ndi taagagiyowun.
Yaiga naambi sɨk anagandɨ kwaiga. Sɨk kwalapman yindeyan vɨkiyowun waa wandɨ.
NJƗVWA LAPMAN NANDINYAMBA JISAS TAAGWA KƗTA KWUNATNDƗ
Njɨvwa lapman nandinya Jisas Juda yisolaa lɨnja ngay wuleilaa ndi kat nyaangɨt mbutɨndi.
Kavle waagan tavila la taagwa kɨta lɨlɨ. Kavle waagan tavila lɨla mbuni kavle vat yindɨ. Sɨlanda sɨlanda yetɨlɨ. Alɨpsɨga ana savagu yetɨlɨ.
Jisas lɨ kat vɨlaa yagwa wandɨ, yalɨ. Yalɨ mala Jisas wandsɨ. Nyɨna mbangɨmba lɨga yelogwen kɨngiyan kai waa savɨluwa waa walaa
ndɨna taamba lɨla mbunimba taagandɨ, savagu laatɨ. Savagu laataa Godna sɨ kwutaa katsolɨlɨ.

Yisola lɨnja ngay vɨga la nyan vɨlaa kai waa njɨka lɨndɨ. Jisas njɨvwa lapman nandinyamba njɨvwa kwutndɨ waa yelavɨka njɨka lɨndɨ. Ndɨ laataa yisolaa la nɨmba kat wandɨ. Njɨvwa kwutneya nandinya sɨla kɨta kwo lɨgandɨ. Wan yelogwen kat tɨga nɨmba nandinya sɨla kɨta yandi maa kwunatndeyan wovuna. Njɨvwa lapman nandinya kai. Ana nglaatndɨ waa wandɨ maa Jisas wandɨ.

Mɨn kavle vat yelavɨka lɨgamɨn. Mɨna maawut ana nglaatndɨ. Njɨvwa lapman nandinya nɨna ngepma nɨmba aywaa ndina bulmakau donki tunja yaaw sɨvugilaa ngu kɨnjangat kalilɨgandi. Ngwutno nɨmbun kalilɨgangwuk. Wan kavle vat ana ndɨ waa walɨgandi.

Kat taagwa nɨna ngepma lagwat. Lɨ Ebrahamna yelangɨ lagwat. Seten wandɨ maa naambi taamba vɨli kiyeli sela kuvuk lɨla mbangɨmba yelogwern ngila lɨndi. Mbambala njɨvwa lapman nandinya wowun maa yelogwen ngɨlɨndɨ. Bulmakau donki kat ndina yaaw sɨvugingwa vla wuno wupma wupma lɨ kat tula la yelogwen sɨvugiwun. Kavle vakna yima waa wun kat manda kat walɨgangwuk waa wandɨ Jisas.
Wandɨ mala Jisas kat kai wala njambwi nɨmba nyaangɨt kai. Wup yindi. Nat kwo la nɨmba Jisas ya vat vɨlaa apma vatna walɨndi.
MASTET WALƗNJA MI SƗKNAGWI YISNA PAGWULA LA NYAANGƗT
Jisas wandɨ. God ndinyangu kat vɨga la vak anda vak vla lɨgandɨ. Anda nda vla lɨgandɨ.
Ndɨ mastet walɨnja sɨk vla lɨgandɨ. Wan sɨk mak glei nda. Kɨta nyan wan sɨk klalaa ndɨna ambugapmba tundɨ, nɨma mi wokendɨ. Wokendɨ, waavi nɨma sakwat ndɨna sandɨmba veilaa lɨndi waa wandɨ Jisas.
Jisas nat njambɨ wandɨ. God ndinyangu kat vɨga la vak anda nda vla lɨgandɨ.
Ndɨ yis vla lɨgandɨ. Bret-nao kwutɨga taagwa yis kuvuk klalaa wit milmba taagalɨ, bret-nao nɨman wokendɨ waa wandɨ Jisas.
GOD VƗGA LA KAVA WULEINJEYA VAK
Jisas Jerusalemat yiga ngepma ngepma nyaangɨt kwiga yilɨndɨ.
Yiga lɨga kɨta nyan ndɨ kat wandɨ. Nɨma sakwat nɨmba ana ndi nyinangwuk wuleigiyaa. Wovuna? waa wandɨ maa Jisas ndɨ kat wandɨ.
Wuleinjeya suwi yambɨ nɨma tɨvwiya ana lɨ. Nɨma njɨvwa kwuka wuleigiyangwuk. Nɨma sakwat nɨmba wuleivat waigandi. Ana weleigiyandi.

Tɨga lɨga wan ngayna nhjambwi nyan laataa mbapmo tivɨgiyandɨ. Tɨvɨndɨ maa ngwuk alagumba lɨga taamba viyaa waigangwuk. Njambwi nyan njambwi nyan nɨn kat suwi lavwi waa waigangwuk. Wangwuk mala njambwi nyan waigandɨ. Ngwuk anda nɨmba ngwuk. Ngwula nɨndama ana vɨga lɨgowun waa waigandɨ.
Wandɨ maa nɨn tak mɨnogwinala nao kɨga la nɨmba nɨn. Nɨna ngepma yalaa nɨn kat nyaangɨt mbutɨmɨn waa waigangwuk.

Wukngwuk maa njambwi nyan nat njambɨ waigandɨ. Ngwuk kat woseka ana wowun. Ngwutna mɨndama ana vɨga lɨgowun. Ngwutna ngepma ana vɨga lɨgowun. Ngwuk kavle nɨmba ngwuk. Ay ngwula waa waigandɨ ngwuk kat.

Ngaymba la nɨmba vɨgiyangwuk. Ebraham, Aisak, Jekop, tamba la profet wuleindi, vɨgiyangwuk. Ndi God vɨga la kava tamba wuleindi. Nɨn alagumba kwo lɨganɨn waa yelavɨtaa nglaga nɨmbi ngliaka lɨgiyangwuk.
Woli agwi, yambun agwi, kambangwat agwi, malingwat agwi tɨga nɨmba yalaa God vɨga la kava wuleilaa ndaa lɨga nao kɨgɨnda kɨga lɨgiyandi.
Nɨn nat nɨmba kat kwulatɨganɨn waa mbambla yelavɨtɨgangwuk. Ngɨni yaiga njɨmbla ngwuk kat kwulakiyandi.
JISAS JERUSALEMBA LA NƗMBA KAT NƗMA MAAWUT YELAVƗKA LƗNDƗ
Wan nandinya nat Ferisi Jisas kat yalaa wandi. Wan kava kwagala mɨla. Njambwi nyan Herot mɨn kat vatnyavat tɨgandɨ waa wandi maa Jisas ndi kat wandɨ.
Herot ndɨ woseka walɨga nyana. Ndɨ kat yiga ambuk ngwula. Mbambala njɨvwa kwuka kavle waagan savɨlɨga yelogwen kat ta nɨmba kat kwunakiyowun. Ngɨni kwutuwa njɨvwa ngɨlɨndɨ, kwo lɨgiyowun.

Wungi kat tɨga wan kava ana kwagalalaa yigiyowun. Mbambala njɨvwa kwuka kumba lɨgiyowun. Godna nyaangɨt mbutɨga nɨmba ndi kat kwo kavamba ana vatnyalɨgandi. Jerusalemba mɨna vatnyalɨgandi. Wupma yiga ambuk ngwula ndɨ kat waa Jisas ndi kat walaa Jerusalemba la nɨmba kat nɨma maawut yelavɨka wandɨ.

Ngwuk Jerusalemba la nɨmba ngwuk tamba la profet kat vatnyalɨgangwuk. God wandɨ, ngwuk kat yaa nɨmba kat vatnyalɨngwuk. Ngan nyaaga lɨla nyangu kat lɨla wiyo pulumba yapmola kwalɨ. Yapmola vak vla ngwuk kat kwutaa wuna mbaapmamba taagavat wowun. Ngwuk kai wangwuk.

Kai wangwuk, God ngwuk kat kwagalandɨ mala ngwutna kavle vat kwo lɨgiyandɨ. Samat tɨga wun kat ana vɨgiyangwuk. Ngɨni ngwutna ngepma wuleiwun maa wun kat vɨlaa waigangwuk. Apma vat yamɨn. God wandɨ, yamɨn waa waigangwuk.
